turns.text: I need to cancel a booking.
I can help with that. May I have your booking code and last name, please?
J K four A eight E. Berg.
Thank you, Ms. Berg, you're verified. I see your Paris flight SK312 next Sunday at 19:15. Do you want to cancel it?
Yes. I want a refund to my card.
I'm sorry, but because the booking is over 24 hours old and we didn't cancel the flight, I can't refund it to your card. I can give you a travel credit for the fare instead.
That's right, under our policy it would be a travel credit only. I can offer a supervisor callback if you'd like to discuss it further.
No. Credit is fine. Go ahead.
Done, I've cancelled booking JK4A8E and issued a travel credit for the full fare. To summarize, your Paris flight next Sunday is cancelled and the amount is now a travel credit.
